text:
incident-bot: Paging on-call (P1) — persistent KV cache read failures and client tail latency spike for a subset of tenants. Alert: kv-store:read_errors ↑ x10, cache-hit-rate ↓ 40% :rotating_light:

mike: saw the spike at 14:02 UTC. errors are 500s coming from the kv read path (kv-shard-7). stack shows fallback to DB reads and timeouts.

lina: joining. link to logs: https://internal.logs/redwood/kv/2123456789 (redacted)

evan: i'm on-call and taking this. quick customer impact: support-bot, do we have lists of affected orgs?

support-bot: Customers with elevated 502s: AcmeAI, NoteSpark, two internal test tenants. Error window started ~13:57 UTC, persisted. Estimated impacted requests ~3.4k/min during peak.

mike: correlating with last compaction job rollout at 13:45 UTC. compactor v2.3.7 changed eviction order; hypothesis: certain key ranges became hot, causing repeated cache churn and a read storm to DB.

eng-lead-jen: if it's cache correctness-related we should prefer correctness over performance. try a targeted bypass for affected keyspaces first, not global off.

evan: agreed. plan: 1) put affected shards into "safemode" (force bypass + read-through protection) 2) apply traffic shaping on outgoing KV reads to DB 3) rollback compactor on shard if needed 4) customer comms. executing now.

mike: patch to enable safemode on shard-7:
```
POST https://admin.internal/v1/kv/shards/7/actions
{
  "action": "enter_safemode",
  "reason": "emergency: read errors and correctness fallback",
  "options": {"bypass_local_lru": true, "consistent_reads": true}
}
```

ops-bot: safemode request queued -> accepted. Expected steady-state: reads served directly without local LRU; will increase DB RPS but avoid corrupted cache reads.

evan: throttle DB read fanout for shard-7 to 250 rps to avoid DB overload while safemode settles. applying rate limit via traffic-controller:
```
kubectl -n infra exec traffic-controller -- /bin/trafficctl set-rate --target=kv_db_read --shard=7 --limit=250
```

sara: rolled that throttle at 14:10 UTC. Observing DB RPS drop from 3.2k -> 240. tail latency for client requests improving but still some 95p spikes.

evan: good. next, disable the compactor rollout for shard-7 and pin to last known-good. mike, can you revert?

mike: creating a pin:
```
PATCH /deployments/compactor-shard-7
{ "spec": { "template": { "spec": { "containers": [{ "image": "compactor:2.3.6" }] } } } }
```

ops-bot: deployment rollback triggered, new pods replacing at 14:13 UTC.

support-bot: Customer-impact update: error rates for AcmeAI down from 18% -> 3% after throttles and safemode. We should prepare short note.

eng-lead-jen: prepare a minimal status update: cause = cache eviction ordering change -> cache churn -> DB fallback; mitigation = safemode for shard-7 + DB throttling + compactor rollback; impact = partial customer errors, mostly resolved; ETA for full recovery 30–60m. Keep it short and technical. @sara take it.

sara: drafting status: "We've implemented emergency safemode and rate-limiting to stabilize reads; rolling back compactor; root cause under investigation. No data loss observed. We'll post a follow-up." Sending in #customers-ops in 5m. :white_check_mark:

lina: monitoring dashboards — cache hit rate for shard-7 recovered from 11% -> 68% (due to safemode behaving as read-through) but overall system token latency still ~p95 480ms.

evan: re-run smoke tests for generation endpoints touching shard-7. if errors persist, we'll extend safemode to adjacent shards.

mike: quick check shows a small subset of keys where KV returns stale-but-corrupt marker; safemode avoids reading that marker. we'll capture keys for a deeper scrub.

ops-bot: scrub job scheduled on shard-7 at 14:25 UTC with low-priority IO cap. Command: `scrub-kv --shard 7 --mode read-verify --limit 100r/s`

support-bot: queued customer follow-ups for impacted accounts; ops will add brief guidance (no data loss, degraded performance).

eng-lead-jen: good triage. next steps timeline: 1) stabilize (now) 2) run scrub + consistency checks (1–2h) 3) remove safemode and reintroduce compactor with canary config (after verification) 4) postmortem. keep page until we remove safemode.

evan: handing off to lina for the remainder of night rotation. I'll be available if escalation needed. handoff notes: safemode enabled on shard-7, DB throttle 250 rps, compactor pinned to 2.3.6, scrub job running, customer comm sent.

lina: ack, i'm on. monitoring alert set. I'll escalate to eng-lead-jen if error rate rises above 5% again.

incident-bot: handoff recorded: from evan to lina at 14:27 UTC. Paging suspended for lower-severity alerts on this incident.

mike: quick log snippet for postmortem collection: `kv: shard=7 key=usr:1234 error=corrupt-marker read_fallback=true` — saving sample keys to s3://incidents/2123456789/samples.json

lina: thanks. i'll capture all commands and timestamps and open the postmortem ticket after full scrub. leaving the thread open. :mag:
